Description:
The Arcane Wyrmfish empowers its translucent fins through its absorption of latent arcane magic imbued in minerals and decaying life that might linger in nearby waters.

Special:

Perceptive Chum

Throw the catch back into the water to gain 25 Midnight Perception for 30 sec.

Throwing multiple catches can extend this buff up to 5 min.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods
- Harandar

Fishing Pools:
- Bubbling Bloom
- Sunwell Swarm
- Blossoming Torrent

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in open water.
